content:
Lena (Growth): Quick sync: launching benchmark newsletter + gated webinar next Tue. Need a tight 3-email nurture for registrants and a 2-email 'clicked but no reg' flow. Main asks: segmentation, send windows, subject tests, and routing for Dedicated/Private prospects.
Omar (Lifecycle): Proposed segments: 1) Engaged: clicked demo/CTA or visited pricing in last 30d, 2) Interested: visited landing >1x but no click, 3) Cold: registered only. Separate VIP Enterprise slice to show concierge CTA.
Zoe (Content): Drafting copy. Confirm email = calendar + 1-pager highlight. Reminder = 48h highlights + chart preview. Day-of = 1-hr push with TL;DR + prompt for questions. Clickers flow: immediate nudge to finish sign-up, then 48h reminder.
Priya (Design): I'll make two templates: modular header for benchmark charts and a compact mobile-first layout. Will include a small testimonial block that swaps for Dedicated customers. Also adding an AMP-lite RSVP button for quick rsvp on mobile.
Malik (Analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_2026&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Tracking: rsvp rate, click-to-rsvp, attend, trial-start 7d. Targets: Engaged RSVP 16%, Interested 7%, Cold 2.5%. Audience est: 52k total, ~6k engaged, ~16k interested, rest cold.
Lena (Growth): Send windows note: respect locale. For APAC pick 10am local, NAM 10am PT, EMEA 11am CET. Avoid Monday mornings for enterprise. Also want a microflow for no-shows: immediate recording + 10d follow-up with product use-cases.
Omar (Lifecycle): Automation rules: when tag `webinar_status=registered` -> campaign benchmark_nurture_v1. Click = +3 lead_score, rsvp +6, attend +20. Clicks on Dedicated CTA route to /ae/queue via webhook.
Zoe (Content): Subject A/B ideas: A:"Benchmark highlights + 1 chart you need" B:"What teams shipped last quarter" C(short):"Benchmark highlights". Preheader test too. I'll attach 3 alt bodies for each segment.
Priya (Design): I'll provide desktop + mobile comps by Wed EOD and a simplified HTML for AMP button testing.
Malik (Analytics): Need internal seed of 50 for QA. I'll provision dashboard and a post-send cohort export. Also will run subject A/B lift with opens->rsvp as primary metric.
Lena (Growth): Owners: Lena (overall), Omar (flows & routing), Zoe (copy), Priya (creative), Malik (metrics). Can we get assets + test sends by Friday?
flow-bot: Ticket created MK-5122 for campaign config, seedlist, and routing. https://app.redwood/boards/MK-5122 :white_check_mark:
Omar (Lifecycle): I'll kick off routing and test sends once assets land.
